The property <MATH_0001>``<MATH_0002> is syntomic''
is fpqc local on the base.

We will use
Lemma <REF_0001>
to prove this. Assumptions (1) and (2) of that lemma follow from
Morphisms of Spaces,
Lemma <REF_0002>.
Let <MATH_0001> be a surjective flat morphism of affine schemes over <MATH_0002>.
Let <MATH_0003> be a morphism of algebraic spaces, and assume
that the base change <MATH_0004> is syntomic.
We have to show that <MATH_0005> is syntomic. Let <MATH_0006> be a scheme
and let <MATH_0007> be surjective and <ACCENT_0001>tale. By
Morphisms of Spaces,
Lemma <REF_0003>
again, it is enough to show that <MATH_0008> is syntomic.
Since <MATH_0009> is syntomic, and since <MATH_0010> is a
scheme <ACCENT_0002>tale over <MATH_0011> we conclude (by the same lemma again) that
<MATH_0012> is syntomic.
As <MATH_0013> is an fpqc covering we conclude that
<MATH_0014> is syntomic by
Descent, Lemma <REF_0004>
as desired.

The property <MATH_0001>``<MATH_0002> is smooth''
is fpqc local on the base.

We will use
Lemma <REF_0001>
to prove this. Assumptions (1) and (2) of that lemma follow from
Morphisms of Spaces,
Lemma <REF_0002>.
Let <MATH_0001> be a surjective flat morphism of affine schemes over <MATH_0002>.
Let <MATH_0003> be a morphism of algebraic spaces, and assume
that the base change <MATH_0004> is smooth.
We have to show that <MATH_0005> is smooth. Let <MATH_0006> be a scheme
and let <MATH_0007> be surjective and <ACCENT_0001>tale. By
Morphisms of Spaces,
Lemma <REF_0003>
again, it is enough to show that <MATH_0008> is smooth.
Since <MATH_0009> is smooth, and since <MATH_0010> is a
scheme <ACCENT_0002>tale over <MATH_0011> we conclude (by the same lemma again) that
<MATH_0012> is smooth.
As <MATH_0013> is an fpqc covering we conclude that
<MATH_0014> is smooth by
Descent, Lemma <REF_0004>
as desired.
